name: Lumina Observation
description: Loop-based observers of the local desktop with anti-spam filtering and an LLM-backed narrator. Phase 3. Read-only (never controls inputs).

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to sample the desktop. 30 s is a reasonable default; 5 s is the floor.

idleThresholdMs.description: Treat the user as 'idle' after this many ms without input. Default 120 s.

enabled.description: Turn on the LLM narrator. Off by default in Phase 3 — start with logs-only, enable when satisfied.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint to call. Defaults to the local Lumina proxy.

model.description: Lightweight model — speed beats depth for narration.

apiKey.description: Optional bearer token for the LLM endpoint.

maxNarrationsPerMinute.description: Hard rate limit so the narrator never spams.
